scope: Controller logic with DOM/event/video stubs only. No native browser, real media, network or rendered behavior tested.

checks.name: Eligible entry uses only the rebased landscape URL, reveals a playing frame and leaves scroll timeline unchanged
Eligible portrait entry and both orientation changes pair the selected real-film path with its matching poster
Manual Pause freezes frame, survives menu/tab/page events and remains a source-free poster on another Home document
Reduced motion starts with zero source/load/play; reversal alone preserves stop and explicit opt-in is revocable
Exposed Save-Data prevents initial attachment and does not resume on reversal; explicit Play can opt in
Menu suspension isolates/restores background, contains Tab focus and never attaches while initially open
Hidden entry avoids loading; visibility and page suspension resume eligible intent without reloading
Autoplay denial retains poster and explicit Play; lifecycle events do not retry either denied attempt
Missing/invalid video hides utility, retains poster, avoids same-source retries and can try the other orientation
Orientation change during retained pause switches to matching poster without attaching another MP4
Late play promise and playing event cannot override a newer manual or policy stop
Loading/stall preserves usable frame and unavailable storage/connection does not break control
